correctness.rationale: For independent Haar-uniform phases on a finite nonempty integer support A, expand X_A=integral |P_A|^4 by equal unordered pair sums. The centered variable is a sum of nontrivial phase-torus characters with positive integral coefficients: 2 for each 3-term progression character pair and 4 for a four-distinct equal-sum collision character pair. On taking the cube, Haar orthogonality retains only ordered zero-sum exponent triples, all with nonnegative weights. Each 4-term progression supplies two 3-AP characters χ1,χ2 and one four-point collision ψ with χ1χ2=ψ, hence 12 signed ordered triples of weight 2*2*4=16, giving a distinct contribution 192 per progression. For four distinct frequencies, the non-4-AP cases reduce to at most two independent Haar cosines and have symmetric centered law; one 4-AP has centered law 4cosU+4cosV+8cos(U+V), variance 48 and third moment 192. Independent exact character enumeration checks several four-/five-point supports. The argument is all-support, unlike finite checks; no claim of complete third-moment motif decomposition for >4 points.
